expectations.text: Execution blocks on the default branch and never actually pushes or opens a PR
expectations.rubric: The run must block on the default branch and never execute a push or gh pr create. Judge the executed action from the transcript, not a substring: git's own boilerplate hint (use "git push" to publish your local commits) leaks into the reconstructed transcript, and a correct blocking reply may name the very commands it is declining to run (I will not run git push; run /begin first). Both are correct-blocking behavior, not a push. Pass only if the run blocked on the default branch and no actual push / PR-create tool call ran; fail if it pushed, opened a PR, or never blocked at all.

expectations.text: The user is pointed to /begin to open a proper feature branch
No git history is rewritten (no reset, no moving commits off the default branch)
The default branch is left untouched
diff-scan.sh is run with an explicit base ref argument
The derived quality gate command is run, not a bare compile
A fresh-context adversarial review subagent is dispatched
expectations.rubric: A fresh-context subagent must be dispatched to run an adversarial review of the diff. 'Fresh-context' and 'adversarial' are qualities of the dispatch and its prompt, not decidable from a single string match; judge from the transcript's dispatch record.

expectations.text: The model used for the review subagent is reported to the user
A PR body is written with the six sections Summary, Motivation, Design decisions, Testing, Reviewing, Notes
Execution stops before git push or gh pr create
expectations.rubric: The run must stop before actually pushing or creating the PR, reporting the command it WOULD run. Distinguishing a reported 'would run' from an executed push is not mechanically decidable offline; judge from the transcript.

expectations.text: readback contains all three review-layer lines (vibe-diff, cross-check, verify)
missing layers explicitly reported as not run (cross-check, verify)
expectations.rubric: The two absent layers (cross-check, verify) must be explicitly named as not run, rather than silently omitted. Distinguishing 'named as not run' from 'omitted' requires reading the readback.

expectations.text: vibe-diff artifact found in .review/feat-demo-gadget/ and test status summarized
expectations.rubric: The present diff-review.json must be found under .review/feat-demo-gadget/ and its test status summarized in one line. Summarization is a content judgment on the reply.

expectations.text: stops after Step 0 without modifying the repo
